title: Ball Security (Example)
about: A small example of the tuning binding. Both rows change the game's own tuning data while the game is running; nothing in your files is edited.

rows.label: Fumble Chance
rows.description: Scales how often a ball carrier fumbles after a hit. Stock is 1.0.

rows.label: Lineman Catches
rows.description: On: linemen may catch passes thrown their way.

rows.label: Every row starts on As installed: nothing is changed until the player picks a value.
